title: A bucket drains and refills
notes: The same requests through a token bucket of 3 that gains 0.3 tokens a second. It is full at 7, so 7, 8 and 9 pass and leave 0.6. 10 finds 0.9 and is refused; 11 finds 1.2 and passes. 12 and 13 are refused, and by 21 the bucket is full again. The same 5 pass as with the counter, for different reasons.
